prompt: A photorealistic image of a sculptor's workshop. A master craftsman has carved a wooden key with extreme precision and intricate detail, perfectly matching every microscopic groove of a single antique lock sitting on the workbench. The key is covered in excessive ornate decorations and ultra-specific notches. On a wall in the background, dozens of other similar-looking locks hang, but the over-designed key clearly won't fit any of them. Natural lighting through workshop windows, shallow depth of field, professional photography, 8K detail. The scene captures obsessive precision that serves only one specific case.
metaphor: A key carved with excessive detail for one specific lock cannot open other similar locks, just as an overfitted model memorizes training data but fails on new data
